name: Almond Creme
instructions: Measure cold water into small bowl
Pour boiling water into medium bowl
Combine milk , vanilla and almond extract
Stir milk mixture into gelatin mixture
Divide mixture between four serving dishes
Arrange kiwi slices and strawberries over each dessert
Gelatin equivalents are one envelope of plain granulated gelatin = 1 / 4 ounce = 1 tablespoon , enough to gel two cups liquid
Sometimes i substitute vanilla sugar for the sugar
This can be found in most european or gourmet markets
Or , make it yourself by combining two whole vanilla beans and sugar in a canister
The ratio of sugar to beans depends on how strong it is as well as how long you let it sit
